title: Compensatory interests: comparisons and limits
summary: The notes separate losses, transfers, and profits before assessing a remedy.
notes: A damages item can serve more than one conceptual measure while still being recoverable only once. Compare investment plus promised returns, the cost of services paid to a third party, a transfer to the defendant, and a lost alternative transaction. Naval Institute supplies a reasonable factual estimate but also rejects an inapplicable profits theory. The early materials do not yet contain a full examination of foreseeability, mitigation, and certainty.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 18–26. Open assigned page 18.
